Tara_Sales: Passing NewBridge Health to CS/Eng. Quick bullets:
- Private deployment (EU), dedicated pool requested.
- Integrations: FHIR v4 realtime + nightly CSV drops.
- SSO: SAML (They provided metadata). KMS + audit retention 7yrs.
- Pilot: target 80 QPS steady, bursts to 280 QPS during daily windows. 5-week pilot.
- Renewal in 9 months; high sensitivity to pilot timing.

Omar_CSM: Thanks Tara. Adding eng/support. Primary onboarding contact: claire.nguyen@newbridge.health (Onboarding PM). Please drop SOW/DPA link.

Tara_Sales: SOW: https://drive.redwood/newbridge/sow_signed_v1.pdf  DPA same folder. Claire will share IdP metadata (already pinged).

Hannah_Support: I'll own VPC peering + firewall rules. Quick question: private control plane hosted in their VPC (peering), correct?

Tara_Sales: Yes, managed private control plane in their VPC.

Ike_Eng: For FHIR I need a sample bundle + auth details. For CSV: avg file size & nightly volume. Also need target SLOs for end-to-end.

Omar_CSM: Claire said CSVs ~100 files/night at ~20MB each. Auth: OAuth2 Bearer for FHIR, SFTP creds for CSV. SLO: 95p ingest latency <350ms, time-to-first-query <4min.

Hannah_Support: Actions I'll take:
- Create support ticket SUP-9701 and upload peering checklist (owner: Hannah_Support) (ETA: 48h)
- Publish firewall/port list + sample runbook (ETA: 72h)

Ike_Eng: Eng actions:
- Create ENG-1580 for FHIR parser + CSV ingestor (owner: Ike_Eng) (initial spike 2 days after samples)
- Capacity plan for dedicated pool + autoscale policy (owner: Ike_Eng) (ETA: 5 business days)

Omar_CSM: Owners & ETAs recap:
- Kickoff scheduling: Omar_CSM (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- IdP metadata collection: Claire + Omar_CSM (ETA: 48h)
- Support runbook & peering doc: Hannah_Support (ETA: 72h)
- Eng connector + capacity draft: Ike_Eng (ETA: 5bd)

Tara_Sales: Risk: they need KMS setup before pilot start. If procurement delays KMS we may need to adjust timeline. Escalate >48h blockers.

Omar_CSM: Acknowledged. I'll track KMS procurement as a risk and set weekly sync cadence. I'll also capture pilot metrics and report back to Sales.

CalendarBot: Meeting created: "NewBridge Onboarding Kickoff" Thu 09:30 CET. Invites: Tara_Sales, Omar_CSM, Hannah_Support, Ike_Eng, claire.nguyen@newbridge.health

Ike_Eng: If NewBridge can upload a redacted FHIR bundle today I'll run a 1-day parse spike.

Hannah_Support: SUP-9701 created: https://support.redwood/t/SUP-9701. I'll post runbook link when uploaded.

Omar_CSM: Closing summary: immediate deliverables: peering runbook (72h), IdP metadata (48h), eng draft (5bd). Ping here for reassignments. :handshake:
